added: Paste a list into an item's name and each line becomes its own row: a weight after the name ("Tent 540 g") fills the weight, a line that names a catalog product arrives linked, and the toast says how many rows were made, with Undo.
changed: A weight after a typed name can be set off by a dash, colon, comma or parentheses: "Tent - 540 g" and "Tent (540 g)" both read as Tent at 540 g.
